newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo in 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo in 10 months.

text.p: Filings for debt relief in Sao Paulo city dropped 41.1 percent between January and October against the same period last year, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said in a statement.
Bankruptcy filings, however, rose 73 percent to 13,161 when compared with the first 10 months of last year, it added.
In October, bankruptcy filings rose 18 percent against the same month last year and 23 percent when compared with September.
Serasa did not give further details.
